svg.title: Longitudinal strain couples to electrons and phonon counts weight transitions
svg.desc: Panel a is a classical longitudinal normal-mode shape u_lat,x/u0=cos(qx), with q u0 much less than one. Its strain and deformation potential are Uac/(D q u0)=-sin(qx), so a displacement maximum need not be a band-edge-shift maximum. Panel b shows equilibrium phonon factors Nq=1/[exp(z)-1] for absorption and Nq+1 for emission, where z=hbar omegaq/(kBT). The dashed curve 1/z is the high-occupation approximation to Nq, not an independent channel.
svg.text: Lattice strain and phonon occupation play different roles
